Sliced Baked Potatoes
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:36pm

Ingredients




4 med. even potatoes
1 teaspoon salt
3 tablespoons melted butter
3 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs
4 tablespoons grated Cheddar cheese or Velveeta cheese
1 1/2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese

Preparation

1 Such as, parsley, chives, thyme or sage or dried herbs of your choice. I use Mrs. Dash. 2 OVEN BAKED: Peel potatoes if skin is tough. Otherwise, scrub and rinse. Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through. Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way. Put in baking dish. Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs or Mrs. Dash. Bake at 425 degrees for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. 3 Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside. Check with fork. 4 MAY BE MICROWAVED 10 minutes at high power. Rearrange potatoes after 5 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave for another 4 to 6 minutes until cheeses are melted, then sprinkle with salt. Good served with meat, fish or poultry dishes or as a main dish with just a salad.
